script_text: A Saturn‑Jupiter square hits your Aries Ascendant, shaking every routine. Monday Sun in your 3rd House sextiles Saturn, sharpening talk. Tuesday Venus conjunct Jupiter in the 4th House sparks romance; Wednesday Mars in the 2nd House sextiles Jupiter for quick cash, yet Saturn’s square weighs commitments. Thursday’s New Moon in Gemini lands in your 3rd House, resetting mental scripts. Friday the New Moon trines Saturn, giving support to launch the revised plan — double‑check details. Saturday Mars sextiles Uranus in your 2nd House, flashing sudden income — act fast, keep receipts; Sunday Venus‑Jupiter fades, leaving calm domestic vibes for low‑pressure love. Thursday is power day — the 3rd House New Moon aligns with Saturn, turning ideas into action. Wednesday drags — Saturn squares Jupiter, inflating duties and muting the Mars‑Jupiter cash spark. Write each new step on paper — Saturn rewards concrete plans over impulse. Follow for daily cosmic updates tuned to your fire sign.
